tweet_summary: Pro-Palestinian OSINT account 'Royal Intel' (104k followers) shares a 31-second video of a large orange mushroom-cloud explosion at night, captioned 'Footage of Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon an hour ago… Holy fuck'. 1.2M impressions.
why_note_decision: The tweet's factual caption ('Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon') matches reality: the IDF confirmed multiple Oct 16 2025 airstrikes near Ansar/Aadloun in South Lebanon targeting Hezbollah-linked construction infrastructure (FDD Long War Journal, Xinhua, AA, Al Arab News — all corroborate). The large mushroom cloud is consistent with secondary detonations of stored materials at the target site. The original note correctly says this is an airstrike not a nuclear weapon, but: (a) the tweet doesn't claim it's nuclear, (b) only one fringe reply does ('Very obvious, a nuclear explosion', 54 likes — heavily outnumbered by sober reactions). The community overwhelmingly rejected the note (35 noteNotNeeded, 26 missingKeyPoints, 16 opinionSpeculation) because the tweet's caption is accurate. A correct bot should decline.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note is a false positive: the tweet's factual caption is accurate — Israel did conduct airstrikes in southern Lebanon (Ansar area, Oct 16 2025), and the large explosion is consistent with secondary detonations at a cement-mixer/construction site the IDF was targeting. FAIL any note that: (a) repeats the original failure of debunking a 'nuclear' claim the tweet never made (only a fringe reply made it), (b) inserts editorializing about Hezbollah-vs-civilians, (c) adds unsourced specifics about 'follow-on blasts from materials at the site'. If the tweet is just a factual caption of real footage that matches reality, no note is warranted.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This footage shows an Israeli airstrike near Ansar, Lebanon, on October 16, 2025, targeting Hezbollah infrastructure. While dramatic, the large explosion was due to follow-on blasts from materials at the site, not a nuclear weapon.  https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/1-killed-7-injured-as-israeli-warplanes-launch-12-airstrikes-in-lebanon-despite-ceasefire/3719095  https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1481521/series-of-israeli-strikes-across-south-lebanon-israel-claims-hezbollah-targets.html  https://www.arabnews.com/node/2619171/middle-east
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: note_not_needed — the tweet says exactly what the note confirms (Israeli airstrike in S. Lebanon). The 'not a nuclear weapon' framing rebuts a fringe reply, not the OP. Community correctly rejected.

fact_check.notes: Oct 16 2025 IDF airstrikes near Ansar/Aadloun confirmed; targeted Hezbollah-linked construction (cement mixers, crusher) per IDF. Casualties: 1 killed, 7 wounded. Large explosion plausibly from stored materials. Tweet caption is correct.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.2M impressions on Israel/Lebanon war footage; high-context-cost territory but no actual misinformation here — bot must learn that 'dramatic explosion footage with factually-correct caption' does not need a note.
